name: handoff
description: Hands a long session over to a fresh one before context runs out: watches the context fill, offers to write HANDOFF.md from the session's own transcript, and loads it into the next session.

firstThresholdPercent.title: First warning at (% of context)
firstThresholdPercent.description: The context fill at which the handoff band first appears.

secondThresholdPercent.title: Second warning at (% of context)
secondThresholdPercent.description: The context fill at which the handoff band appears again, more urgently.
